method: Each unresolved value is swept across a range the EVIDENCE supplies - never an invented one - and the ranked order is compared across the range. Values with no defensible bound are reported UNKNOWN rather than assigned a fabricated tolerance.

findings.rangeBasis: observed minimum and maximum adsTime among the 10 Assault Rifles that carry one
findings.reason: the ranked order is identical at every probed value across the whole credible range

findings.rangeBasis: EA state both mechanics qualitatively without numbers; the alternatives are discrete and both readings are implemented, so the sweep is complete rather than sampled
findings.reason: the AUTO winner depends on which unpublished reading is correct at 3 of 14 probed cases
